#### Gradients in a deep network

Take two [MLPs](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network) for the digits with 10 [hidden layers](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-hidden-layer) of 32 [unit](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-unit)s each,
one with the [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-logistic-function) as its [activation function](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-activation-function) and one with the [ReLU](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-relu).
At their starting weights,
how does the size of the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) of the mean training loss with respect to each layer's weight matrix change from the last layer to the first?

:::
